scientific.integrity: The theorem is obtained by applying fixed positive task multipliers to every source RotoGrad update channel. Normalization cancels each factor in task directions and relative-convergence ratios, while the common magnitude becomes a weighted arithmetic mean and task-specific first-order gradients retain their own factors.
limitations: Positive task multipliers are fixed from initialization.
Independent-scale identities are pointwise at matched states.
Full trajectory equivalence is claimed only for common scaling with reciprocal compensation of both displayed learning rates.
No empirical performance or convergence-rate consequence is asserted.

title: RotoGrad has an exact arithmetic-mean task-unit law
